verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents first-party Agent Skills (pre-built and custom), official client SDKs in seven languages with streaming and retry support, tool use, and an MCP connector, so the model can be wired into custom agent loops. Claude Code is also offered as its own coding agent. However, the evidence never documents official integrations into third-party coding agents or agent frameworks, and no dedicated agent-framework SDK or plugin is described. missing for 10: documented official integrations or plugins for third-party coding agents and agent frameworks, a first-class agent-framework SDK beyond the general Messages API clients, independent hands-on corroboration of plugging the model into external agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the model into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, official integrations — skills, plugins, or first-class SDK support

citations.quote: Anthropic provides pre-built Agent Skills for common document tasks (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, PDF), and you can create your own custom Skills
Skills are reusable, filesystem-based resources that give Claude domain-specific expertise: workflows, context, and best practices that turn a general-purpose agent into a specialist.

Client SDKs: General-purpose Messages API clients for Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, and Ruby. Each SDK provides idiomatic interfaces, type safety, and built-in support for streaming, retries, and error handling
Claude's Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector feature enables you to connect to remote MCP servers directly from the Messages API without a separate MCP client
Direct model prompting access | Custom agent loops and fine-grained control
